meta.title: The second vendor is blocked as well when it is the one rejected

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, the request the case itself writes.
A second QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).

plan.title: The second vendor is blocked as well when it is the one rejected

assert.say: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing)

expected.message: You are not allowed to perform this action
